# Google Places (x402 only)

Three routes, each a straight pass-through to Google with the gateway's own Google credential injected:

| route | price | body |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /google/places/v1/places:searchText` | 0.04 USDC | `{"textQuery":"…","maxResultCount":5}` |
| `POST /google/places/v1/places:searchNearby` | 0.04 USDC | `{"locationRestriction":{"circle":{…}},"includedTypes":["cafe"]}` |
| `GET /google/places/v1/places/<place id>` | 0.03 USDC | — |

**Send `X-Goog-FieldMask`.** Places (New) requires it and answers 400 without one; ask
for what you need, e.g. `places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress,places.rating`.
Request and response shapes are Google's own: <https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service/text-search>.

For agents: quote with `buy_pay_quote`, then pay through `buy_curl` with `maxAmount` set to
the quote's `maxAmountRequired` (atomic units, six decimals), or with the CLI's
`buy curl --max-amount 0.04` (whole tokens). Payment is irreversible; a request Google
rejects for a malformed body is still paid, so validate the body first — an unpaid request
answers 402 and is free.
